title: knautia dipsacifolia subsp. arvernensis
intro: Knautia dipsacifolia subsp. arvernensis, commonly known as Arvernian scabiosa, is a plant species within the family Caprifoliaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions attributed to Arvernian scabiosa include its ability to calm and soothe the nervous system, as well as its potential to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
